roadmap.goal: Every completed update writes one Information line saying which entity, in which mode, how many records it saw, how many it fetched and how long it took - and stops writing the per-entity, per-item stream that currently buries it. mode is hard-coded full in this slice so later slices change the data, not the format.

validation.notes: Approved with zero findings at every severity. All 10 [Test] methods claimed across 7 steps with no orphans (three steps deliberately un-ignore a sibling pair in one cycle, matching DISTILL's pairing). Walking skeleton (scenario 1) lands in Phase 01. Dependency chain and ordering match DISTILL's handoff: counts (01-01) then the line (01-02) then the demotion pass. Criteria checked against the actual assertions, not the test names - no contradictions. Shared-contract blast radius fully claimed, including both hand-written test fakes.

out_of_scope: Any change to what is fetched - not one remote call moves in this slice
Any UI; /api/v1|latest/update/status is untouched (Epic #5511 owns the view)
Structured-logging framework changes, log sinks, correlation ids, OpenTelemetry

phases.name: The line and the numbers
phases.description: An update reports what it did: a SyncOutcome carrying mode and both counts, persisted on RefreshLog and rendered as one Information line.

steps.name: A team sync reports its mode and both counts
criteria: SyncOutcome record carries Mode, RecordsScanned, RecordsFetched
ITeamDataService.UpdateTeamData returns Task<SyncOutcome>
TeamUpdater writes Mode, RecordsScanned, RecordsFetched onto RefreshLog
Existing RefreshLog fields EntityName, ItemCount, Success, ExecutedAt unchanged
Mode is Full; scanned equals fetched in this slice
steps.implementation_notes: DDD-7. Blast radius measured in DISTILL: ITeamDataService has one production caller (TeamUpdater); IWorkItemService.UpdateFeaturesForPortfolio has one production caller (PortfolioUpdater) plus two hand-written test fakes in API/Integration/PortfolioDeleteSerialisationTests.cs and TeamDeleteSerialisationTests.cs which must change in the same commit. Counts originate where the fetch happens: RecordsScanned = records the connector returned, RecordsFetched = records whose payload was downloaded (equal in slice 01). Existing Moq setups of UpdateTeamData across the suite now return a null Task<SyncOutcome> unless set up - guard or update the setups. No model change, so no migration; the RefreshLog migration already shipped in DISTILL.

steps.name: A completed team update says what it did
criteria: One Information line per completed team update, marker 'Update completed'
Line carries entity type, entity name, mode, scanned, fetched, duration, success
A failed update emits the same line with success=false
The error is still logged at Error level with its exception
steps.implementation_notes: Un-ignore A_completed_team_update_says_what_it_did and An_update_that_failed_still_says_what_it_did together - the failure path is the same emit site in the finally block. Contract fixed by DISTILL DT-1: 'Update completed | <Team|Portfolio> <name> | mode=<full|delta> | scanned=<n> | fetched=<n> | duration=<n>ms | success=<true|false>'. mode/scanned/fetched/duration/success are asserted tokens; the rest of the prose is free. Structured logging: message template placeholders, never string interpolation.

steps.name: A portfolio update says the same thing
criteria: IWorkItemService.UpdateFeaturesForPortfolio returns Task<SyncOutcome>
PortfolioUpdater writes the same three fields onto RefreshLog
PortfolioUpdater emits the same line shape naming Portfolio and its name
The two hand-written test fakes implementing IWorkItemService are updated
steps.implementation_notes: The line shape must be one rendering routine shared by both updaters, not two copies - the criteria assert an identical shape and slices 02-08 change the data behind it. Natural home is UpdateServiceBase or a small helper it owns.

phases.name: The demotion pass
phases.description: Everything the update iterated over moves to Debug. Nothing is deleted. Baseline measured in DISTILL: 153 operator-visible lines for a 25-item team refresh, 416 for a 25-Feature portfolio refresh.

steps.name: A team update announces itself once
criteria: 'Updating Work Items for Team' appears at most once per update at Information
The connector-side copies are demoted in the same change
The connectors' own tests stay green
steps.implementation_notes: DISTILL upstream issue 2: the connector copy sits below the faked port, so the AT cannot observe it. A green AT is not proof the connector copy is gone - verify it by reading the code. Three copies exist today: WorkItemService.UpdateWorkItemsForTeam, WorkItemService.RefreshWorkItems, and one per connector.

steps.name: Per-record chatter leaves the operator's log
criteria: Per-item and per-Feature narration is Debug or lower
The same narration is still emitted at Debug, never deleted
Warnings and errors are untouched
steps.implementation_notes: Fragments the scenario greps for: 'Extrapolating' and 'Items to Feature', both from the extrapolation pass a portfolio update runs. The scenario's second assertion is a positive control - the narration must still appear at Debug, otherwise the negative assertion passed for free.

steps.name: An update costs the operator two lines
criteria: At most two Information-or-above lines per entity per update
Holds for a 25-item team refresh and a 25-Feature portfolio refresh
Every demoted line still exists at Debug
Errors and warnings untouched
steps.implementation_notes: Un-ignore both budget scenarios (team and portfolio) together - they are one criterion measured on two paths. DISTILL upstream issue 1: the demotion list in the slice brief is shorter than what this criterion requires. The test is the boundary, not the bullet list. Known additional sites: 'Updating / Done Updating Features for Portfolio', 'Updating / Done Updating Remaining Work for Portfolio', 'Owning Team for Portfolio', 'Feature Owner Field', 'Found following teams', 'Added {n} Items for Feature {x} to Team {y}', 'Using Percentile', 'Features had following number of child items', '{Percentile} Percentile Based on', and TeamDataService's 'Updating / Finished updating Team Data'.

steps.name: A skipped entity says nothing to the operator
criteria: A cycle that skips an entity emits no Information line naming it
'Checking last update' is emitted at Debug
The per-entity 'Last Refresh of ... was N minutes ago' line is Debug
steps.implementation_notes: Both scenarios in this fixture un-ignore together - one demotion, asserted from both sides. Sites: UpdateServiceBase.UpdateAll 'Checking last update for {Entity}', TeamUpdater.ShouldUpdateEntity 'Last Refresh of team ...', PortfolioUpdater.ShouldUpdateEntity 'Last Refresh of Work Items for Project ...'. The loop's own lifecycle lines ('Starting Update for {UpdateType}', 'Done Updating {UpdateType}') are outside the per-entity budget and stay at Information.
